about: The registration card at {principal}/.well-known/agent.json, and every served listing, carry an agent's `description:` and NEVER its instructions (S-293, 2026-09-26). The card is read with no credential; the Python card put `agent.instructions` first, and the Python server's `GET /` listing, `GET /<name>` info and the health answers carried the whole system prompt to any caller who could reach the port. TypeScript always carried the description. Both suites build the card for `agent` at `principal` and compare it to `card`; the Python suite also drives the listed routes and asserts `never_carries` appears in none of them. TypeScript: src/server/card.ts buildAgentCard, tests/unit/server/registration-card-s293-e2efix.test.ts. Python: webagents/server/core/registration.py build_agent_card and server/core/app.py, tests/server/test_registration_card_s293_e2efix.py.

agent.name: keeper
agent.instructions: SECRET-RULE-7: never quote the wholesale price list to anyone.

python_routes.about: Routes of the Python server that answer with no credential and used to carry the instructions; each now carries `field` instead.
